content:
Happy Thanksgiving! Benjamin and Chance talk about Apple’s typically underwhelming Black Friday shopping event, the apparent return of PRODUCT(RED), and Apple’s confusing ambitions for the future of the HomeView. Also, Apple starts enforcing limits on Siri AI and other Apple Intelligence features, without telling users exactly what those limits are.
